::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/retries"}
#docs
Cursor-paginated. A dedicated read rather than a filter on /invoices: columns like last error, refusing gateway and failed card come from the invoice's latest FAILED transaction. Object is `retry`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of rows to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |
| `sort_by[asc]` | `string` | no | Sort ascending by this field. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort descending by this field. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The invoices that are waiting for a retry. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `retry`. One of `retry`. |
| `data.invoice` | `string` | The invoice's id (inv_…). |
| `data.invoice_number` | `string` | The invoice number. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The invoice status. |
| `data.dunning_status` | `string` | in_progress \| parked \| succeeded \| exhausted \| stopped. Null until dunning first touches the invoice. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The retry's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.amount_due_minor` | `integer` | The amount due in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.collection` | `string` | `reminder` when auto-collection is off (the subscription's setting, else the customer's): dunning sends payment reminders and never charges, so `attempt_count` stays 0 and `next_attempt_at` is the next reminder. `charge` for a retried payment. One of `charge`, `reminder`. |
| `data.attempt_count` | `integer` | Charge attempts made. Always 0 on a `reminder` row. |
| `data.next_attempt_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The next retry, or the next reminder on a `reminder` row. A time in the past is due: the next clock tick acts on it. |
| `data.retry_started_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The retry started time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.written_off` | `boolean` | Settled by a write-off. `status` is `paid`, but nothing was collected: the row is under `given_up`, not `recovered`. |
| `data.customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `data.customer_name` | `string` | The customer name. |
| `data.customer_email` | `string` | The customer's email address. |
| `data.last_error_code` | `string` | The last error code. |
| `data.last_error_id` | `string` | The last error id. |
| `data.last_error_text` | `string` | The last error text. |
| `data.last_failure_retriable` | `boolean` | true = soft, false = hard, null = never recorded. |
| `data.last_failure_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The last failure time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.gateway_key` | `string` | The gateway that processed the payment. |
| `data.payment_method_brand` | `string` | The payment method brand. |
| `data.payment_method_last4` | `string` | The payment method last 4. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |
| `total` | `integer` | Total number of rows. |
